revisions.name: $uop_fast
revisions.reason: Review 20261125 --uop-opt 0x004 (default off): $pc steps over the 79/80/87 pending CALL/RET seams only while $dao_status and $pending_armed are both 0, where $pending_push/$pending_pop/$pending_entry return without effect. No EIP write, target, guest stack or invocation lifetime changes; callback ownership remains pending. Review 20261126 --uop-opt 0x4000 (default off): op 111 SAHFI runs $th_sahf's body inline ($load_eflags of $build_eflags with AH's SF/ZF/AF/PF/CF) and steps $pc by 4. No EIP write, target, guest stack or invocation lifetime changes; callback ownership remains pending. Review 20261126 --uop-opt 0x800 (default off): op 112 RETX is a RET whose target no call in the program names. It reads the popped address from a temp, and leaves to the deopt stub (threaded code at the RET, ESP untouched) when the address is 0 or any of $thread_return_slot, $null_transfer_on, $cs_enabled, $callback_feed_enabled is set, so every recorder $th_ret owns still runs there. Otherwise it calls $pending_pop(address, ESP) under the same dao_status|pending_armed gate as seam op 80, adds 4+imm to ESP, and goes to a flags stub; op 113 EXITR then sets $eip to the popped address with EXIT/EXITB budget semantics. Same EIP and guest-stack effects as $th_ret on its no-recorder path; no new invocation lifetime; callback ownership remains pending. Review 20261126b (0x800): op 113 EXITR, after its unchanged EIP write and with blocks left, may continue at the code $uop_ret_chain returns for that EIP -- the live program compiled there, after the same stamp/S1/window steps as its enter op, and only when $branch_end would have dispatched that enter op (no debug, yield, breakpoint, SBH, 16-bit, census or pending-context state). No new EIP write or target; guest stack untouched; callback ownership remains pending.

revisions.name: export:init_thread
revisions.reason: Review 20261126 uop-opt A1: the main thread (tid 0) picks its micro-op arena from --uop-opt bit 0x8000 ($UOP_ARENA_BIG instead of $UOP_ARENA) before the existing $uop_set_arena flush. Data placement only: no guest callback, invocation, context restoration or scheduling change; worker arenas unchanged. Ownership remains pending.
